title: Cross-mission canonical artifact input binding — governed consume of ACCEPTED artifacts from sibling missions
description: Fixes FAIL_CLOSED_PLAN_DATAFLOW_UNBOUND_INPUT for bound missions consuming already-accepted artifacts produced by earlier sibling missions. New canonical seam: ArtifactDependencyResolver.listEligibleExternalInputSources(mission) enumerates ONLY ACCEPTED+re-verified artifacts from missions sharing the consumer's authorized Objective lineage (bound_open_id→work_open_binding→work_item→workforce_allocation→objective→sibling children→bound mission ids; no lineage/other objective/own-mission = empty; CAP-bound, fail-closed on overflow). bindPlanExternalInputs() stamps PAIR-reserved metadata.pair_dataflow_sources (contract pair-external-artifact-input.v1) pinning consume_name + immutable source identity (artifact_id/sha256/byte_size/source mission/task/governed/execution/executor) — exactly-one match binds, zero stays UNBOUND, >1 FAIL_CLOSED_PLAN_DATAFLOW_AMBIGUOUS_SOURCE; planner-emitted stamps are stripped (reserved key); rebind drift/conflict FAIL_CLOSED_PLAN_DATAFLOW_SOURCE_BINDING. requiredEdges skips only source-bound consumes (in-plan producer rule unchanged); assertPlanArtifactStructure proves stamp shape+no double-bind; assertPlanDataflow(external_input_artifacts) re-proves pinned identity vs CURRENT eligible set. Reconcile (canonicalize seam), initial runPlanning and replan all thread input_artifact_sources; resolveForConsumer re-runs the eligible set NOW and emits canonical DependencyArtifactEntry (producer_* = durable source identities) so dispatch, pinForGovernedTask, materializeForConsumer and the remote acread1 lane are unchanged; materializeForConsumer's expected producer mission derives from the producer's durable execution row (same-mission invariant relaxed truthfully). 17-case focused suite: positive bind+assert, idempotent replay, byte-exact materialization end-to-end; adversarial: absent/arbitrary source, ambiguous same-name artifacts, no lineage, cross-objective isolation, forged planner stamp, tampered sha, conflicting replay identity, corrupted CAS, revoked state, out-of-scope stamp, in-plan rules and same-mission handoff preserved. Regression: f2-handoff 53 + planner-dataflow-incident 125 + f1-authority 20 + f2-r1 43 + delivery/prv2a/ops suites all pass; known pre-existing baseline flake pair-f4 R5.1-crash fails identically on BASE 1f6d4af.
